Merrett, with Lowers second and Alan Sexton third. In the 100 yards (under 19) we only had five runners and Frank Kemp was the winner in the good time of 10.4 seconds.
We did well in the 220 yards, with Merrett first and Alan Sexton third, while Ray Tooby won the half-mile and Mick Porter was third in the 1 mile.
The 220 yards saw Sexton and Merrett running for the Club, and with the 1st two only qualifying, Alan was 3rd in his heat, but Denis came 2nd in his, and so got through to the semi-finals.

Walden and Merrett were 1st and 2nd in the 100 yds. trophy final, with Alan Sexton being placed 3rd in the 440 yds. Bob Taylor was 2nd with Ian Badiali 4th in the 880, and Don Maclean was 2nd in the 1 mile.
We had three runners pass on to the 2nd round of the 220 yds. in Denis Merrett, Ivan Mayers and Basil Walden, but only Merrett progressed further and he was eventually 4th in the final of this event.

Denis Merrett won the 100 yds. in 10.3 secs., but we had no finalist in the 440, and although Peter Bagnall qualified for the final of the 880 yds., he found the effort too much for him and failed to finish.
The sprinters did well with Basil Walden defeating the holder C. Gibbs, to win the 100 yards, with D Merrett 3rd and J.
A new holder was also produced in the Senior 100 yards, the finalists being Mayers, Walden, Butler, Merrett, Key and Holtum., Merrett eventually winning from Mayers with Walden third.
Merrett, Holtum and Mayers all qualified for the semi-final of the 220 yards and Merret and Mayers went on to the final in which Dennis was third and Ivan fifth.

The highlights of this year's Championships, held on 15th and 16th July, as far as Belgrave was concerned. was the excellent running of Ron Holtum to be the first Belgrave Harrier to reach the final of the 100 yards, for as long as most of us can remember, and Dennis Merrett's third place in the 220 yards Hurdles.
